scenes.say: Cheating pays. Once. Cheat someone you'll meet two hundred times and watch what happens.
Repeated games: how you treat someone today decides how they treat you tomorrow.
One round: the cheater gets {one_shot_defect}. Tit for Tat gets {one_shot_tft}.
{rounds} rounds: the cheater ends with {rep_defect_gain}. Two cooperators get {coop_pair} each.
When the future is long enough, reputation becomes an asset, and cheating becomes a losing strategy.
Act like you'll meet them again. In a small world, you usually will.
